units.goal_1: % of persona flights operated, strike days excluded (target >= 98)
units.goal_2: % of canceled or 3h+ delayed persona flights rebooked or refunded within 24h (target >= 90; 100 if none)
units.goal_3: complaints per month, weeks 1-10 average, calibrated so this run's weeks 1-3 = dossier baseline 2,500/month (raw scale-up if weeks 1-3 have no complaints)
units.goal_3b: NPS proxy from end check-in 3a: % 5s minus % 1-3s (baseline +12)
units.goal_4: % of planned fare revenue weeks 5-10 kept on Kestrel by personas with a flight then (target >= 96)

note: persona counts are small; read these with the confidence intervals on the dashboard
